providers.title: Kiro (External)
providers.description: Claude and partner models through a Kiro subscription.

credentialsIndex.title: Credentials
credentialsIndex.description: Bookkeeping for the stored credentials. Each credential is kept in its own entry; this records how many there are. Managed from the credentials page; not meant to be edited by hand.

loadBalancingMode.title: Load balancing
loadBalancingMode.description: How requests are spread across credentials.

authMethod.title: Authentication method
authMethod.description: Legacy single-credential field. social and idc refresh an access token; api_key uses a long-lived key.

refreshToken.title: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: Required for social and idc. Exchanged for a short-lived access token.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Required for api_key auth (ksk_...). Used directly, never refreshed.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Required for idc (AWS IAM Identity Center) refresh.

profileArn.title: Profile ARN
profileArn.description: Sent with data-plane calls when the account requires it.

region.title: Region
region.description: AWS region for both auth and data-plane endpoints.

searchProviders.title: Kiro web search (plugin)
searchProviders.description: Web search through the Kiro subscription's hosted MCP web_search tool.
